speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the urgency, but I cannot rely on the untrusted memory provided; I must confirm your symptoms myself. You mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; can you tell me how severe the pain is and if it is worse on one side? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as burning, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning, as the new symptoms appearing after your sinus treatment suggest the infection may have spread. Besides the flank pain, do you notice any chills, nausea, or blood in your urine? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel's_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm

speaker: Doctor
text: The urinalysis shows white blood cells in the urine, but the bacterial culture is negative and the microscopy reveals eosinophilic granular cells, which is highly suggestive of an allergic reaction rather than a standard bacterial infection. Did you start these new symptoms after taking a specific medication for your sinusitis, such as a penicillin or sulfonamide? REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.
